work.name: University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign
work.summary: Advised by Prof. Vikram Adve at UIUC
highlights: Architected a high-performance graph partitioning engine in Rust to solve complex, multi-objective partitioning problems using heuristic-based local search; presented poster at CSL Student Conference '26.

Led AI research project on developing LLM-based code generation techniques for low-resource programming languages, with applications in IT automation and agriculture; authored 'An Empirical Comparison of Code Generation Approaches for Ansible', peer-reviewed paper presented at InteNSE '24 (ACM/IEEE).

work.name: University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign
highlights: CS 421: Developed course material, graded papers, and tutored students in advanced Compilers course.

work.name: UCSB ArchLab
highlights: Created Sootty, an open-source VCD waveform viewer for hardware simulations in the terminal. Added support for integration with PyRTL; mentored undergraduate students on the project.

Contributed to a paper using program synthesis for processor development. Designed a pipelined RISC-V core and extended a hardware description language to support holes for sketch-based program synthesis.
Worked with a graduate student to create a formalization for system-on-chip protocols.

work.name: UCSB Programming Languages Lab
highlights: Extended MOSEL, a language of monadic second-order logic on strings, to describe DFA, NFA, and regex problems. Designed and created a C++ command-line tool to automate problem generation for use in upper-division Formal Languages classes.
Designed automated practice-problem generation tools for CS education, focusing on algorithmic logic and student engagement. Presented research poster at RACA-CON '20.

work.name: University of California, Santa Barbara
highlights: Mentored students in upper-division Data Structures & Algorithms and Object-Oriented Programming over five quarters; led technical review sessions and evaluated complex assignments.
Graded assignments and gave personalized feedback to students.
Led group review sessions and provided one-on-one support.

work.name: Jobvite, Inc.
highlights: Built integration testing framework for Jobvite's Candidate Scheduling interface with Selenium WebDriver.
Automated a suite of QA test cases; collaborated with other developers using Git in an agile development environment.

work.name: Baobab Studios
highlights: Performed QA testing on scenes in Crow: the Legend, an Oculus Virtual Reality game.
Wrote scripts to automate audio/video conversion with ffmpeg to support mobile platforms.

work.name: Los Alamos National Laboratory
highlights: Synthesized a quantum dot display for the Bradbury Science Museum.
Wrote feature identification code to analyze experimental image data using Igor.

work.name: National Park Service — Youth Conservation Corps
highlights: Performed hands-on trail maintenance and construction in Yellowstone National Park.
Gained experience in forest management, land stewardship, and safety protocols through fieldwork and training.

volunteer.organization: Free and Open Source Silicon Foundation
highlights: Supervised multiple students in the development and release of an open-source CLI-based waveform viewer.

volunteer.summary: UC Santa Barbara's inclusive, student-run hackathon
highlights: Led a cross-functional team of 15 organizers to run a large-scale virtual hackathon; oversaw end-to-end logistics including technical infrastructure, budget management, and stakeholder outreach for 500+ participants.
Mentored students at all-female-identifying hackathon.
